brief.objective: A Toronto rapper, singer and songwriter whose music spans hip-hop, R&B and pop. His albums include Take Care, Views and Scorpion.

creativeThesis: One night in Toronto told through a record: the needle drops, the city listens, the sleeve comes home.

intent.product: Drake's music catalogue, album era Take Care, Views, Scorpion
intent.audience: TikTok listeners 18-34 who stream late at night
intent.message: Drake's albums are the sound of Toronto at night.

realWorldGrounding: Toronto skyline with the CN Tower and Lake Ontario at night
OVO Sound vinyl releases (Scorpion 2LP) as physical collectible objects
albums named from the brief: Take Care, Views, Scorpion

selectedGoal.title: Toronto After Midnight
selectedGoal.description: A needle lands on a spinning record, a hooded listener in headphones watches the Toronto skyline from a high window, and a record sleeve rests on the sill against the city lights. It sells the music as the soundtrack of the city at night, with no face on screen.
selectedGoal.style: Night navy, sodium amber and warm gold; practical light only; 35mm grain; shallow depth of field.

styleTags.cameraLanguage: macro push-in, locked window wide, slow dolly

decisionEvidence.selectedReason: Atmospheric Toronto-at-night piece that names all three brief albums and promotes the music through record, city and listener without likeness.

referencesUsed.title: Vinyl drop-the-needle listening clips (TikTok #vinyltok)
referencesUsed.why: Vinyltok's dominant format: a hand lowers the needle on a spinning record in warm low light, the first note lands on the cut. Sound-first, tactile, no face needed. Metrics unknown (search returned no usable counts).

referencesUsed.title: Night-city album visualizer rollouts (skyline at 2am, car windows, rooftop silhouettes)
referencesUsed.why: Transfer from the music-video/visualizer world: rollouts sell an album era through a city mood (skyline, rain on glass, late-night drives) rather than a face. Complex's vinyl guide confirms OVO Sound physical releases (Scorpion 2LP) as collectible objects. Metrics null.

creative.reason: A coherent, moody Toronto-at-night piece: record, silhouetted listener under the CN Tower, sleeve hero, with album names only in captions and end card. The opening needle drop is subtle, so the first-second hook is soft.
creative.biggestProblem: Hook is a slow push-in rather than a clear needle drop.

slopHits.note: tonearm already near the record; drop barely reads
